title: Java Vittoria - Una bicicleta hibrida que da que hablar - Zona3

takeaways.text: Full carbon (Toray T700/T800) frame with Shimano 105 Di2 2×12, a Decap 52/39 crank and an 11–34 cassette.
Comes with a carbon Volex TT disc rear wheel and an 80 mm front wheel on 28 mm Continental tires; the shop notes tire and saddle brands vary between shipments.
The hybrid bar has extensions with pads for a semi-aero position, though the presenter doubts it suits full triathlons.
The seat-tube area hugs the rear wheel so closely that only a little finger fits between them.

disclosure: Filmed in a Chilean shop selling the bike; Spanish automatic captions.
summary: A Chilean shop walkaround of the carbon JAVA Vittoria road/triathlon hybrid with Shimano 105 Di2 and a disc rear wheel.
